description: Data-only plugin UI evaluation, authoritative types and bounds live in flare-plugin-protocol/ui.rs.

fields.name: payload
fields.description: Typed UI evaluation envelope defined by the shared UI protocol. presentPluginMessage, invokePluginAction and pluginDetail accept an optional messageId (server id or clientMsgId) of the message the card belongs to: the card resolves over the shared and local state layers stored on that message, and invoke stores a successful operation's data.sharedState and data.messageState on it. invokePluginAction also takes formValues and selection; pluginDetail also takes cursor and previous for the next page of a paged detail.
